reason: Stone stairs go down from the flagstone plaza into the crypt, so the sky shows over the stairwell.
A pit dug from the surface down to a walled yard at L-3, with wooden platforms over it at L-1 and L-2.
A secret tunnel from the cellar of the plastered house to the slate building. Its ladder comes up under a wooden box, and the hole in the house floor drops past it.
The secret tunnel is lit through the hole in the house floor at 65,-36.
The upper of two ramps out of the grass hollow stands on half-stone, so it is stood on one step higher than a ramp on bare floor.
